answer: That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Because the dune burn is logged at the ocean settlement, the jade audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 81% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 284 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
